parameters.name: IsGaInstance
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to query the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Valid values:
- yes: Queries the GA instance status.
- no: Queries the attachment details between the GA instance and the live streaming link.

parameters.name: VideoCenter
parameters.description: The live center. Valid values: cn-beijing, cn-shanghai, cn-shenzhen, cn-qingdao, ap-northeast-1, ap-southeast-5, eu-central-1, and ap-southeast-1, ap-south-1, which represent the live centers located in Beijing, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Qingdao, Japan, Indonesia, Germany, and Singapore.
